__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="ranged-dpm-advice" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>&gt; </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Ranged DPM Advice</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This channel will go over general damage output lessons, ability prioritisation, a learning path, and style-specific solutions for common PvM concerns</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Knowledge of in-game ability/item descriptions is assumed, this guide aims to tie the tools together rather than list what they do</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For general PvM terminology, damage tips, and revolution bars, check out their respective sections in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To compare abilities, use </nowiki>[https://tools.runescape.wiki/rs-rot/ranged <nowiki>RS Analysis' Ranged Page</nowiki>]<nowiki>, and add your gear</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="core-ranged-rotation"><nowiki>&gt; </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Core Ranged Rotation</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This section covers rotations using core style abilities before later unlocks are obtained</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>See </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Advanced Ranged Rotations</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> section further down for info on ranged rotations using best-in-slot gear</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>A typical Ranged rotation uses the strongest Basic Abilities available to build adrenaline, and spends it on the strongest available Enhanced Abilities, Ultimate Abilities, or Special Attacks</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To achieve this, we must think about the following </nowiki><strong><nowiki>key considerations:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Basic ability patterns </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Buff usage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Ammo effects </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="basic-pattern"><ins><nowiki>Basic Pattern</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>The basic pattern comboes Galeshot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> into Rapid Fire </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when both cooldowns are available</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be thought of as </nowiki><strong><nowiki>buffing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + 3 abilities of your choice</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, adding additional damage onto each hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Therefore, try to follow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with strong multi-hit abilities </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → 3 Abilities] → [Filler] → [</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → 3 Abilities] → repeat</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ranged has other rotational synergies that help to fill empty ability slots</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Snipe </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + Piercing Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Imbue: Shadows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + Shadow Tendrils </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When building adrenaline, fill with available Basic Abilities:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ricochet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Piercing Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Basic Attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1" alt="rangedbasic" title="rangedbasic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Then spend adrenaline on Enhanced Abilites, Ultimate Abilities, and Special Attacks:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Such abilities are often categorically referred to as </nowiki><strong><nowiki>spenders</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Snap Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deadshot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Snipe </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + Shadow Tendrils </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> don't spend adrenaline but are still considered Enhanced Abilities</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If adrenaline is limited, prioritise having enough adrenaline for your next </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> combo</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ With these considerations, we can ensure that cooldowns are always cycling to allow for a consistent flow of strong abilities</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="deaths-swiftness"><ins><nowiki>Death's Swiftness</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>It is assumed that either the Planted Feet perk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Greater Death's Swiftness unlock has been obtained </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for the purposes of this guide.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Death's Swiftness </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is the main buff to prioritise whenever there is an opportunity to deal damage</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The exception to this is when the fight would end too quickly, or mechanics occur, and you can't benefit from the full duration</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ideally, enter boss fights and important phases with 100% adrenaline so you can activate it immediately</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In Death's Swiftness </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, continue following the basic pattern while fitting in your most powerful abilities:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• [</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki>] → [Fill w/ Basics and Spenders] → [</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → ...]</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ While waiting for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown, you do not want to needlessly camp 100% adrenaline, and can start building when </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is nearly ready to use again</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="other-buffs"><ins><nowiki>Other Buffs</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Besides Death's Swiftness, Ranged has multiple supportive buffs that are meant to supplement and enhance its core rotation</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Imbue Shadows</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> grants adrenaline per hit and is extremely important to pair with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Synergises with multi-hit abilities </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and is vital to maintain a consistent flow of adrenaline during your damage buffs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep in mind that Damage-over-Time (DoT) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1" alt="corruptshot" title="corruptshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> does not count as a hit for the purposes of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Shadow Tendrils</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> extends </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> duration and should always be used once during a full </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Deathspore Arrows</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be used to get a free </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, allowing for tremendously accelerated rotational setup</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 12 stacks can be obtained through a combination of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if necessary</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Start building </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in advance of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown so as to not waste time once it's available</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rare situations may not allow enough time to stack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, in which case a form of adrenaline potion </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can help with buff setup</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because of ranged's reliance on multi-hit abilities for both damage and adrenaline, it is highly recommended to prioritise obtaining Greater Ricochet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Igneous Kal-Xil </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalxil" title="igneouskalxil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> upgrades as early as possible in the style's progression</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="ammo-effects"><ins><nowiki>Ammo Effects</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Due to having considerably stronger and more consistent effects, </nowiki></em><em><nowiki>it is recommended to use bows + arrows</nowiki></em><em><nowiki> over crossbows + bolts in the current state of the game. The information in this guide will assume that the highest available tier of bow + arrows are being used.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>When using abilities, stronger ammunition can increase your ability damage and provide additional effects</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use Ful Arrows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Deathspore Arrows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> together for general use</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use Black Stone Arrows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/785031580149743617.png?v=1" alt="blackstonearrow" title="blackstonearrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Wen Arrows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1" alt="wenarrows" title="wenarrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when hit chance is needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1" alt="wenarrows" title="wenarrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are otherwise equal to or worse than </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> unless boss mechanics provide downtime to build stacks for free</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Otherwise, use the highest tier of generic ammunition available or Jas Bane arrows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1" alt="jasdragonbanearrow" title="jasdragonbanearrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if applicable</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When using Pernix's Quiver </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626450296892.png?v=1" alt="pernixsquiver" title="pernixsquiver" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, multiple keybind options are available that make ammo cycling easier</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (1) </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Quiver Slot:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Drag the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>empty</nowiki></ins><nowiki> quiver slot from your gear interface onto an action bar to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>cycle ammo in any currently equipped quiver</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (2) </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Specific Quiver:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Drag a specific quiver onto an action bar to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>either equip the quiver or, if already equipped, cycles its ammo</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• (3) </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Quiver ammo slot 1 + Quiver ammo slot 2:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Utility Abilities in the ranged ability book which </nowiki><strong><nowiki>cycles ammo to the selected slot</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/DKjsxOkobI.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="rotation-examples"><nowiki>&gt; </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Rotation Examples</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>These are only suggestions to work from, and will not necessarily be applicable at all bosses or situations. For boss-specific rotations, see their respective guides.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="starting-unlocks"><ins><nowiki>Starting Unlocks:</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ring of Vigour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1" alt="rov" title="rov" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or its passive effect after </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Extinction <nowiki>Extinction quest</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Greater Death's Swiftness </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095409580420374568.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswiftcodex" title="gdeathsswiftcodex" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Planted Feet perk </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1" alt="pf" title="pf" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Shadow Tendrils </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Greater Ricochet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1095409587110293665.png?v=1" alt="gricocodex" title="gricocodex" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in later examples</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Breaking down this example into blocks:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Buffs start + build adrenaline: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Basic pattern 1: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fill w/ basics + spenders: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Basic pattern 2: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Buffs end + build adrenaline: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ends) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1" alt="rangedbasic" title="rangedbasic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1" alt="rangedbasic" title="rangedbasic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Basic pattern 3: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061858622537809.png?v=1" alt="rangedbasic" title="rangedbasic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ We cut this one off short since </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> comes back up</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Buffs come off cooldown: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Most rotations will follow this overarching pattern, though each block may be executed differently depending on available upgrades</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Deathspore Arrows Example</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Arrow swaps during rotations are denoted with the arrow before the ability </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki>

<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Greatly increases the availability of adrenaline during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, allowing us to minimise basic ability usage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Outside of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, we spend some adrenaline sparingly and make sure to have enough to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on time with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>These rotations demonstrate typical ways of setting up the initial round of buffs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while sticking to the basic pattern. With further upgrades, this rotation can be progressively iterated upon, with increasing availability of adrenaline allowing for more powerful spenders to be incorporated.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="pvm-decision-making"><nowiki>&gt; </nowiki><ins><nowiki>PvM Decision Making</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Next, we explore some challenges that ranged commonly runs into during PvM and the tools and decisions it uses to solve them</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="area-of-effect-aoe"><ins><nowiki>Area-of-Effect (AoE)</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Decimation Special Attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1" alt="decimation" title="decimation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is ranged's most powerful and versatile AoE tool</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Moderate 3-tile AoE search range with no cooldown, a minor adrenaline cost, and can be set up before enemies spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Combo with powerful abilities like </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to quickly deal with AoE scenarios</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Every additional hit counts for the purposes of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> adrenaline gain, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack generation, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reduction on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is not active, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be an adrenaline-efficient way to make use of the effect</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Most often used from an Essence of Finality amulet (EoF) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to allow use with higher tier weapons</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Bombardment </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306391265284.png?v=1" alt="bombard" title="bombard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used to quickly deal with low life point targets</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Upfront damage that doesn't require a prior ability cast to set up, but has more restrictive 2-tile AoE search range</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Outclassed by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618477879328.png?v=1" alt="decimation" title="decimation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if enemies would live for 3 or more abilities, or are spread further apart from each other</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Low Priority or Highly Situational</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ricochet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061867288100885.png?v=1" alt="ricochet" title="ricochet" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> has a large 5-tile AoE search range, but does low damage and is generally not used for AoE purposes</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Corruption Shot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306294796299.png?v=1" alt="corruptshot" title="corruptshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> also has a 5-tile AoE search range, but should only ever be used for that specific aspect of it</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Due to being DoT, does not benefit from damage buffs </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, but can deal moderate damage while under </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="spending-excess-adrenaline"><ins><nowiki>Spending Excess Adrenaline</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>High-level ranged spenders involve various stored EoF special attacks </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in order to optimise away from just spamming </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Gloomfire Bow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Dark Bow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are used as the main </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> options</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is overall better in most cases, but </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is a cheaper early pickup and has a faster hit timing</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Some endgame rotations may be written using both for their respective advantages</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Eldritch Crossbow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> provides a significant damage buff anywhere you're able to pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1" alt="splitsoul" title="splitsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (~15-30% depending on ability)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Seren Godbow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is a high-damage, low-cost spender against any 5x5 or larger targets</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Comparable damage even to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when it can be used to its full effectiveness</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If physical </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is your highest tier weapon, using their special attacks </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> directly is also a powerful option</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Aim to replace most instances of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with these spenders</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="short-damage-checks"><ins><nowiki>Short Damage Checks</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Some PvM scenarios emphasise short phases and quick damage checks rather than keeping up a consistent flow of damage</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In such cases, ranged has some of the following options:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stacking </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697046925362.png?v=1" alt="wenarrows" title="wenarrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ahead of time for a temporary stronger damage + hit chance buff than </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Abilities and buffs that can be used ahead of time </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is obtained, lining up high-damage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> procs can significantly contribute to your burst damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On 5x5+ targets </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used flexibly for high on-demand damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stalling abilities to release them with other spenders once these phases begin</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="sustaining-with-ranged"><ins><nowiki>Sustaining with Ranged</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Ranged has to frequently lock itself out of healing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or inflict self-damage </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in order to maximise damage output</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To plan around a lack of sustain, consider the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Prioritise lossless defensive and healing tools </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641337999170207763.png?v=1" alt="excal" title="excal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as your first resort</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Familiarise yourself with boss mechanics to anticipate periods of heavy or little incoming damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Optionally introduce </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> into rotations </nowiki><em><nowiki>after</nowiki></em><nowiki> becoming comfortable at a boss</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Leave a few abilities of downtime in between </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to give yourself a chance to heal up</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ It is mainly important that it overlaps with your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> pattern</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drop </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if unable to maintain sufficient </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1" alt="splitsoul" title="splitsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> uptime for it to be worthwhile i.e. during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994914159969976440.png?v=1" alt="zamorak" title="zamorak" kind="icon" /><nowiki> twinshot</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Replace </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with a better spender if you don't actually need the extension on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="advanced-ranged-rotations"><nowiki>&gt; </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Advanced Ranged Rotations</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This section focuses on tactics that make full use of endgame tools available to ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Players looking to optimise around Bow of the Last Guardian </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Elite Dracolich </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179717430436704306.png?v=1" alt="edracobody" title="edracobody" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should use this section as reference.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Assumed Unlocks:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Greater Ricochet </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Igneous Kal-Xil </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalxil" title="igneouskalxil" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Gloomfire Bow EoF </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Interchangeable with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/745279787471470713.png?v=1" alt="eof" title="eof" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is obtained, though adrenaline will differ due to the lower hit-count</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Conservation of Energy relic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773711921195.png?v=1" alt="conservationofenergy" title="conservationofenergy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Fury of the Small relic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773917573233.png?v=1" alt="furyofthesmall" title="furyofthesmall" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Used while testing listed rotations but it may not be necessary for all of them</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Berserker's Fury relic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774106185768.png?v=1" alt="berserkersfury" title="berserkersfury" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is the stronger damage option when adrenaline isn't an issue</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="eldritch-crossbow"><ins><nowiki>Eldritch Crossbow</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Split Soul </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1" alt="splitsoul" title="splitsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Special Attack acts as another buff in ranged's rotation that synergises with its main ability patterns</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Since </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> heals more from powerful multi-hit abilities </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1" alt="splitsoul" title="splitsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> similarly scales well off those same abilities</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Therefore it's important to maintain high uptime on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1" alt="splitsoul" title="splitsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> especially during your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + 3 abilities pattern</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> which was mainly used for adrenaline and rotational filler becomes a powerful ability when comboed with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Example (1 minute):</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ 12 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/900758234527301642.png?v=1" alt="deathsporearrows" title="deathsporearrows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image <div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="bow-of-the-last-guardian"><ins><nowiki>Bow of the Last Guardian</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Optimising Perfect Equilibrium </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> procs can result in some of the largest possible DPS increases for ranged. To understand how to plan around this effect, it's important to keep in mind hit-counts for common abilities:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1 stack:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> only generates 1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack no matter how many secondary arrows land</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>2 stacks:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061863723073636.png?v=1" alt="piercingshot" title="piercingshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>3 stacks</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>7 (-1) stacks:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ It may be helpful to think of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as </nowiki><strong><nowiki>generating -1 stacks</nowiki></strong><nowiki> (since it leaves you with 1 less </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack than you started)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>8 (0) stacks: </nowiki></strong><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Will put you back at the same number of stacks you had before</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Proc Priorities:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Gloomfire Bow Special Attack</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be used at 1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active or 5 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks if not</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is sensitive to the order that hits occur, so this ensures that the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> proc uses the powerful 3rd hit of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Dark Bow Special Attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></strong><nowiki> is more flexible than </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> around starting stacks but deals less overall damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Snipe</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is an extremely powerful single hit and can usually be fit in between </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> uses</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Snap Shot</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is typically only used as filler to increment stacks since its damage is strictly worse than other options</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>BoLG Special Attack </nowiki></strong><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should always be used at least once early during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to activate its buff</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The attack in itself does not deal tremendous damage and should not be heavily prioritised once the buff is active</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• When used from anywhere between 3-7 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks, will proc </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and reset stacks to 0</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This detail can be useful for setting up consistent rotations, since you can treat </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as a stack reset at the beginning of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Building a Rotation</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Plan </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks around the structure of abilities that are used regardless of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Keep to the basic pattern of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061860371828929.png?v=1" alt="deadshot" title="deadshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>these abilities don't care about </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stacks to be strong</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should still be primarily used to extend </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061866193518744.png?v=1" alt="imbueshadows" title="imbueshadows" kind="icon" /><nowiki> rather than as a proc since </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is calculated using pre-critical strike damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Plan around using ability sequences that line up multiple strong procs, the following are some suggestions:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack start:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1446178203608809472.png?v=1" alt="gloomfirebow" title="gloomfirebow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643848618553507843.png?v=1" alt="dbow" title="dbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061855732666439.png?v=1" alt="snapshot" title="snapshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061857486143498.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /></p>
